name: Pepper mill
summary: Tall wooden pepper grinder with a curved waist and a round knob on top; for dining table and kitchen scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the grinder stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the grinder is hero size (~375 px wide, ~800 px tall); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, pop = scale in with overshoot
